propositions: KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS table contains four rows (_rebar_env, _env_int, _str_pref, _int_pref) with no matching function definitions under src/rebar, violating the stated invariant 'Signatures verified against the current tree'
Ghost rows remain unfalsified by the generator because scan() validates only the tree-to-table direction, leaving no table-to-tree validation to catch helpers that no longer exist
A ghost row exempts unowned env reads from the config-ownership gate by name, allowing calls to nonexistent helpers to pass validation that would reject calls to unknown helpers
The held-out oracle in test_check_config_ownership_heldout.py depends on dict insertion order and silently passes because its fixture resolves to a ghost helper at position 0
Renaming _str_pref to _gate_str_pref without updating the table row caused REBAR_GATE_REF and REBAR_GATE_SOURCE to vanish from docs/env-vars.md, undetected by --check for three days

A fail-closed seam validating KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS rows against DEFAULT_SCAN_ROOT must be added, symmetric to the existing tree-to-table validation, to restore the missing diagnostic and prevent future silent key loss
